gloss: great supporting actor; excellent supporting player

definitions.gloss: great supporting actor; excellent character actor
definitions.explanation: An actor who excels in supporting roles, adding depth and quality to a production without being the lead.

definitions.gloss: excellent supporting player; key contributor in a secondary role
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively for any person or thing that plays an outstanding secondary role, supporting and enhancing the main element.

notes:
Combines the prefix {名|めい} (fine, distinguished, masterful) with ⟦{脇役|わきやく}→脇役：13933_wakiyaku⟧ (supporting role). The {名|めい} prefix elevates ⟦{脇役|わきやく}→脇役：13933_wakiyaku⟧ from merely "supporting actor" to one who is recognized for excellence in that role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名|めい}{脇役|わきやく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧: known as a great character actor
- {名|めい}{脇役|わきやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揃|そろ}う→揃う：01953_sorou⟧: a lineup of excellent supporting actors
- {名|めい}{脇役|わきやく}⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: distinguished supporting actor

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese film and television place high value on supporting actors, and {名|めい}{脇役|わきやく} is a genuine term of respect. Many beloved actors in Japan are celebrated specifically for their career-long excellence in supporting roles. The concept is also frequently applied outside entertainment to describe anything that fulfills a supporting function superbly.
